blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A bill was filed to allow and encourage residents to install electric generation and storage systems in order to address high power rates in the country, Parañaque Rep. Brian Raymund Yamsuan said on Tuesday. Yamsuan in a statement said that these forms of renewable energy setups, which allow users to generate their own electric power while ensuring that these does not seep through lines going toward the power grid, will be institutionalized by House Bill (HB) No. 11459 and other measures seeking a proposed Sariling Kuryente Act.
